MoveAnything! has no key. Type /move key: MoveAnything! has no key. Type /move key <key> to set one. Example: /move key F7.
The key %s opens MoveAnything! now. It n: The key %s opens MoveAnything! now. It no longer does %s.
Type /move to open or close the window. Type /move FrameName to move a frame by its name. Type /move pick to pick a frame on the screen. Type /move hide FrameName to hide or show a frame. Type /move done to stop moving all frames. Type /unmove FrameName to put a frame back where the game puts it. Type /move key <key> to set a key for the window. Type /movelist to see the saved layouts, /movecopy Name to copy one and /movedelete Name to delete one.
